note: Begin with a familiar school journey by bus. Compare train and taxi for the town visit, then walking for a nearby library. A clearly introduced second travel situation extends the same pattern to an airplane and a boat; it is not a magical bus–plane–boat trip. A bus, a train and an airplane all appear explicitly. Bus/car/bike stay ordinary text; train/taxi/airplane/boat/walk/by are this lesson’s yellow targets. No unintroduced going, ride, goes, airport or get on yet.

lesson.title: 6.2 Ways to Travel
lesson.unit_outcome: Name places and transport, explain a current destination, complete a trip, follow directions, ask for help, choose a service and check its times.
lesson.goal: Identify transport and connect it to familiar journeys; explicitly practise a bus, a train and an airplane.

steps.cast: Children taking school bus; navy-jacket train traveller; separate light-blue-shirt taxi traveller; Ana walks into library then arrives inside; Ana airplane example; navy-jacket male traveller and burgundy-jacket companion riding boat.

turns.speaker_listener: Use the exact authored speaker; third-person/place narration is not the pictured person's self-speech.
turns.props_before: The complete named place, action or relationship is visible in this intended scene.
turns.props_after: No unspoken object transfer or relationship change; proceed to the next authored beat.

steps.learner_state_before_choice: Picture and guided two-word completion or full word bank; translation remains on demand.
steps.response_image_timing: No image-derived social-reply question in Recognize. Listen follows exact audible dialogue; turn images cannot add answer-revealing heroes.
steps.after_success: Retain the resolved action/ownership above; advance only to the next listed beat.
steps.wrong_and_replay: Wrong choice keeps the current beat and shared teaching feedback. Replay repeats the same initiating audio/turn order without substituting another scene.
steps.review_state: Storyboard intent only; current pixels, phone crop, voice binding and heard recording need separate review.
